# A world in a sentence: Hyperion

[The](ow://title/068e2dde-8d1f-7dd2-8000-6178241a68ab)[Hegemony](ow://institution/068e2f37-840a-7b3b-8000-41b6b6872c95) [Consul](ow://character/068e2ddb-83c6-71a7-8000-a45b8b711e25) sat on the balcony of his ebony spaceship and played Rachmaninoff's Prelude in C-sharp Minor on an ancient but well-maintained Steinway while great, green, saurian things surged and bellowed in the swamps below.
